plan_review.notes: Alternatives: tactical-only wounded spacing/add handling (too narrow for bad boss admission); shared boss-admission plus tactical follow-through (adopted); planner/SLACK_AWARE architecture (rejected because legacy/legacy is the gate and planner is time-oriented). Resolved all concerns by preserving the healthy 6-ft ranged baseline, scoping outward bias to wounded contact pressure with hysteresis, using combat readiness as boss-entry signal with slack only as bounded override, adding deterministic add-vs-boss switching, sharing entry logic across legacy/planner paths, bypassing active battles, and strengthening unit/control coverage.
